# AI visibility auditing - reference pages

> 24 reference pages on measuring whether AI answer engines cite a brand.
> Written for SEO consultants and small agencies, not for brands buying an audit.

Every URL below resolves to a page matching its description. This file is kept
accurate or removed - a stale llms.txt is worse than no llms.txt, and this site
is held to the same standard it describes.

## Understanding it

- [What Is an AI Visibility Audit?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/): An AI visibility audit checks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews name a brand...
- [AEO vs GEO vs SEO: What the Terms Actually Mean](https://fercasanovas.github.io/aeo-vs-geo-vs-seo/): AEO and GEO are two names for the same practice: getting named inside an AI-generated answer.
- [Which AI Platforms Should You Measure?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/which-ai-platforms-to-measure/): Track ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews — the four platforms an SEO consultant...
- [What Counts as a Citation in an AI Answer?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/what-counts-as-a-citation/): A citation is any place an AI-generated answer names, quotes, links to, or clearly draws from a specific...
- [Why AI Search Traffic Does Not Show Up in Your Analytics](https://fercasanovas.github.io/ai-traffic-in-analytics/): AI answer engines rarely send a click, so GA4 has almost nothing to attribute to them.
- [Is AI Visibility Worth Measuring Yet?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/is-ai-visibility-worth-measuring/): For some clients, yes; for others, not yet.
- [We Checked 50 B2B SaaS Sites for AI Crawler Access. Here Is What We Found](https://fercasanovas.github.io/ai-crawler-access-study/): Two-thirds publish an llms.txt — a convention no AI platform has committed to reading.
- [About CassaInnova](https://fercasanovas.github.io/about/): CassaInnova publishes the AI Visibility Audit Kit: a documented method for measuring whether ChatGPT,...

## Doing the work

- [How Do You Check Whether a Client Is Being Cited in AI Search?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/how-to-check-ai-citations/): Sign out, open a private window, and ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google the same realistic buyer...
- [Why Do AI Search Results Change Between Runs?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/why-ai-results-change/): Answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews can give different answers to...
- [How Do You Build a Prompt Set to Test a Client's AI Visibility?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/building-a-prompt-set/): Write a small set of realistic category questions, never the client's brand name.
- [Does llms.txt Actually Do Anything?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/does-llms-txt-work/): No platform has committed to reading it.
- [How Do You Check Whether AI Crawlers Can Read a Site?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/ai-crawler-access/): Load the site with a crawler's user agent instead of a browser's.
- [Does Schema Markup Affect Whether AI Cites a Site?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/schema-and-ai-citation/): Nobody has published proof that schema markup directly causes an AI engine to cite a site.
- [A Brand Vanished From AI Answers. What Happened?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/brand-disappeared-from-ai-answers/): A brand missing from an answer it used to appear in usually isn't one thing.
- [How Often Should You Re-Measure AI Visibility?](https://fercasanovas.github.io/how-often-to-measure/): There's no fixed interval that's right for every client.

## Note on this file

`llms.txt` is a proposed convention, not a standard. None of the answer engines
these pages discuss has published a commitment to reading it, and it is not an
access-control mechanism. It is published here because it is cheap and carries
no known downside, not because it is expected to change anything.
